title: Remove Text from an Image Online
description: Clean unwanted text overlays from an image with a fast, private online processing workflow.
heading: Erase unwanted text overlays from images
intro: Prepare cleaner visuals for personal projects, presentations, or authorized marketing assets—without opening a full editor.

process.heading: How to Remove Text from an Image
process.intro: Erase an unwanted text overlay in three simple steps—no brushes, layers, or full editing software required.

steps.title: Upload Your Image
steps.description: Choose a JPG, PNG, or WEBP image up to 10 MB that you own or have permission to edit.

steps.title: Remove the Text
steps.description: The tool processes the visible text overlay while working to preserve the surrounding image details.

steps.title: Review and Download
steps.description: Compare the before-and-after result, then download the cleaned image through a temporary link.

faq.heading: Questions About Removing Text from Images
faq.intro: Find answers about supported formats, image privacy, and which text overlays you may remove.

items.question: What image formats are supported?
items.answer: You can upload JPG, PNG, and WEBP images up to 10 MB.

items.question: Are my images kept private?
items.answer: Files are stored in private object storage and scheduled for automatic deletion after 24 hours.

items.question: Can I remove any watermark?
items.answer: Only edit images you own or have permission to modify. Some protected or complex marks may require manual editing.
